# T-1: Make gate inference transitions atomic

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Stage inferred gate lifecycle changes as a validated value and commit them only after gate evaluation and required persistence complete.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R1-R2 make phase resolution and transition construction side-effect free.
- R3 preserves byte-identical state at validation, agent, and artifact-write failures.
- R4 applies the explicit recovery transition exactly once after completed persistence.
- R5 retries without duplicate transitions, findings, issue-log success entries, or artifacts.
- R6 preserves direct exports, configuration resolution, registry hooks, artifacts, and explicit/inferred semantic behavior outside the corrected failure boundary.

## Implementation Notes
Replace eager inference mutations in `RunGateCommand.execute` with a dedicated pending transition class that composes existing lifecycle transition and GateMutationOwner behavior. Keep the commit point after the existing phase-specific gate work and required artifact persistence; do not add a generic transaction layer.

## Test Strategy
Update phase-inference unit coverage and add spec-local fault-injection tests for validation, agent, and artifact-write failures, valid PASS/FAIL completion, repeated commit, and bounded two-attempt retry. Add direct-export, registry pre/post/onError, existing agent/config resolution, artifact-name, issue-log, retry-accounting, and routing parity assertions.
